default.label: Record
default.title: Every call captured, with nobody taking notes
default.text: Fieldnote joins Zoom, Meet and Teams calls, or records in the room on your phone. Transcripts arrive minutes after you hang up, with speakers labelled.

image.alt: A recorded interview with a live transcript beside the video

default.label: Tag
default.title: Themes that build themselves while you read
default.text: Highlight a sentence and tag it, or accept the tags Fieldnote suggests. Every highlight lands on a shared board, grouped by theme across all your interviews.

image.alt: A board of highlights grouped into themes with counts

default.label: Share
default.title: Clips your whole team will actually watch
default.text: Turn a theme into a two-minute reel of customers saying it in their own words. Send it to Slack or drop it into Jira next to the ticket it explains.

image.alt: A highlight reel being shared to a Slack channel
